$description: The neutral part of the design system: what every brand's generated theme has, under the same names (Scribe*), so shared code compiles against any brand. It is kept small: surfaces, text, edges, the two button fills, the accent, the brand colour, status, focus, ink, the ruled line and doubt, with the type ramp, spacing, radii, sizes and motion. Everything else is a brand's own and stays in that brand's own type. A brand whose token has another name maps it under $extensions.<brand>.neutral.roles (neutral name, then the brand's token). accent is what the user can act on or follow beside the buttons: links, the progress bar. brand is identity only (the mark, the wordmark, brand moments) and is never the colour of something to act on. windows and web name the system colour a role takes in a Windows contrast theme and under forced-colors.
